evidence_quotes: Synthesis of CMF from Main Hydrolysate. In a typical procedure, 1 mL of main hydrolysate and 3 mL of the organic solvent of choice (chlorobenzene, fluorobenzene, bromobenzene, anisole, 2chloroanisole, 1,2-dichloroethane, o-difluorobenzene, toluene, 2phenyldodecane, or dodecane) were introduced in a single Ace glass high-pressure rated tube.

The reaction was carried out at 80 °C for 3 h under magnetic stirring. After completion, the reactor was cooled to room temperature. The organic phase was then collected, and the remaining aqueous phase was washed with an additional 3 mL of the organic solvent of choice for 1 h under magnetic stirring at room temperature. The organic layer was isolated, and the washing step was repeated twice.
